Picked GZCLP: GZCLP is the standing default for a 3-4 day barbell strength goal past the absolute-novice stage: double progression with a proven T1/T2/T3 shape. T1 Barbell Squat starts at 140 lb (from 185x5, e1RM 187 lb after form allowance). T1 Barbell Deadlift starts at 170 lb (from 225x5, e1RM 228 lb after form allowance).
